name: approach to preterm labour overview
title: Contractions or fluid before 37 weeks: membranes intact with no cervical change is threatened preterm labour (hydrate, treat a urinary infection), with a dilating cervix is preterm labour (tocolysis to buy 48 hours for steroids under 34 weeks and transfer), ruptured membranes is PPROM (confirm, antibiotics, steroids), and an imminent birth adds magnesium sulfate under 34 weeks and penicillin for group B streptococcus; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

root.title: Contractions or fluid before 37 weeks: what has CHANGED, and what does each step buy?
lines: history: gestational age · previous preterm birth, cone biopsy, smoking · contractions: when, how often, how long · bleeding? leaking fluid? infection?
exam: Leopold's for presentation · fetal heart rate · cervix: dilatation, consistency
causes: early maternal or fetal HPA axis activation · inflammation, infection · decidual hemorrhage · uterine overdistension · idiopathic
case: 25 y G3P2 at 29+2 · previous births at 36 + 32 weeks · cone biopsy · smokes 1 pack/day · on vaginal progesterone · contractions every 5–10 min

groups.title: Membranes INTACT: is the cervix DILATING?
lines: either can still settle without delivery

head: h
Threatened preterm labour
signs or symptoms of labour
inv: a UTI can cause these symptoms

head: h
Preterm labour
contractions DILATING the cervix before 37 weeks
pres: e.g. every 5 minutes, 2 cm and soft
tx: • also ↓ intraventricular hemorrhage, necrotizing enterocolitis, perinatal death
the other use of the 48 hours

head: h
Preterm prelabour rupture of membranes (PPROM)
before 37 weeks, before labour
pres: • cause: infection, inflammation, mechanical stress, bleeding
tx: • < 32 weeks untreated: 50% deliver in 48 h, 75% in 7 days
• antibiotics lengthen latency: longer = better for the baby

head: h
Imminent preterm birth
prepare the baby
tx: • intravenous (IV) bolus, then infusion, to the mother
2 · IV PENICILLIN if GBS + or unknown
↓ GBS sepsis in the newborn · penicillin first-line if no allergy

panels.title: Who is at risk
items: multiple gestation · assisted reproduction · age at either extreme
cervical surgery (cone > loop excision) · uterine malformation, fibroids
chronic disease (diabetes, hypertension, renal, autoimmune) · connective tissue (Ehlers-Danlos)
smoking, substances · no prenatal care · non-Hispanic Black (socioeconomic confounders?)
short cervix · infection, esp cervicitis: gonorrhea, chlamydia, bacterial vaginosis, trichomonas, ureaplasma, mycoplasma

panels.title: Why preterm birth matters (risk depends on GESTATION)
items: respiratory: respiratory distress syndrome, apnea of prematurity, bronchopulmonary dysplasia
intraventricular hemorrhage · necrotizing enterocolitis · retinopathy of prematurity
long NICU stay · high health-system cost
